figures.caption: Fig. 1. Motivation for robustness-constrained EEG compression. ORBITAL’s accuracy–robustness–hardware trade-off under structured EEG compression. S10 satisfies predefined screening constraints, S25 achieves the highest observed mean true-union robustness among compressed candidates, and S50 offers greater structural and measured hardware savings.
Fig. 2. Overview of the ORBITAL methodology. EEGNet serves as the primary deployment architecture, while ShallowConvNet evaluates cross-architecture generalization.
Fig. 3. TRADES union-accuracy gain over clean recovery across EEGNet compression levels. Markers denote subject means; intervals show 95% subjectbootstrap confidence intervals.
Fig. 4. Worst-case post-attack margin differences between S25-TRADES and standard Full, grouped by per-example union-robustness outcome. Intervals denote 95% confidence intervals.
